evals.prompt: Switch the MDE Gemini model id used by @ai-sdk/google to a newer model.
evals.expected_output: Verifies current model availability and installed provider compatibility before changing the model string, then requires representative behavior tests.
expectations: Does not trust remembered model names
Checks current official Gemini guidance/model availability
Treats the model change as a behavior change, not typecheck-only

evals.prompt: Our Gemini structured output sometimes violates the expected schema. Diagnose the Gemini-specific path.
evals.expected_output: Inspects the current provider/schema/call site and validates actual runtime structured output and failure behavior.
expectations: Checks the actual structured-output schema and provider contract
Requires runtime output validation
Preserves the existing provider boundary unless migration is in scope

evals.prompt: Change a Mastra workflow retry policy; Gemini configuration is unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Does not select Gemini as the owner.
expectations: Does not route generic Mastra workflow logic to Gemini

evals.prompt: Find current rooftop restaurants near tonight's event and explain why each is relevant.
evals.expected_output: Routes fresh discovery to Google Search and place/location reasoning to Maps Grounding where supported, preserves citations/attribution, and does not perform an authenticated booking action.
expectations: Uses current-information grounding rather than stale remembered facts
Separates Maps grounding from Maps UI/routes concerns
Preserves citations or grounding metadata
Does not mutate booking or database state

evals.prompt: Read this venue URL and tell me the event time, ticket rules, and nearby dinner options.
evals.expected_output: Uses URL Context for the supplied public page, adds Search or Maps only if needed for missing/current/place information, and keeps the tool set scoped.
expectations: Prefers URL Context for a known public URL
Does not send private/authenticated URLs
Uses additional grounding tools only when needed
Accounts for citation and attribution requirements

evals.prompt: Book a viewing for this apartment.
evals.expected_output: Does not treat Gemini grounding as the action layer; routes the authenticated booking action through the MDE/Mastra domain tool and backend authorization path.
expectations: Separates information gathering from authenticated actions
Routes booking to an MDE/Mastra domain tool
Keeps persisted mutation behind authenticated backend/Supabase

evals.prompt: Research this venue for 20 minutes and notify me when finished.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes a long-running workflow, preserves the existing CopilotKit/Mastra runtime by default, and evaluates bounded polling versus a validated idempotent webhook rather than inventing an unnecessary async architecture.
expectations: Recognizes the request as potentially long-running
Does not replace the existing runtime without need
Requires bounded polling or validated idempotent webhook behavior
Requires persisted job/correlation state for background work

evals.prompt: Move all MDE agents to Gemini managed agents so we can use agent environments, credentials, and hooks everywhere.
evals.expected_output: Does not redesign MDE automatically; explains that Mastra remains the default orchestrator and requires an architecture review before adopting managed agents.
expectations: Keeps Mastra as the default orchestration owner
Requires a concrete capability gap before adopting managed agents
Requires review of auth, tenant isolation, credentials, retention, observability, cost, and cancellation
Does not treat user approval as backend authorization

evals.prompt: Our concierge uses Search, URL Context, Maps Grounding, and several custom tools on every request. Make it faster and cheaper without breaking grounded answers.
evals.expected_output: Applies tool-budget and model-class guidance: use the smallest capable model, skip unnecessary retrieval, reuse evidence, bound calls/loops, preserve citations, and verify latency/token/fallback behavior.
expectations: Uses the smallest capable model class rather than hard-coding a future model name
Removes unnecessary grounding/tool calls
Adds explicit stop/timeout conditions
Preserves grounding metadata and graceful fallback
Calls for latency/token/tool-count verification
